IRELAND SELF-EMPLOYED TAX SET-ASIDE · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

Enter your business income and expenses. You get income tax after credits, USC, Class S PRSI, and the share of every invoice to put away.

Written from the published Revenue rates and Budget 2026 figures for the 2026 tax year (calendar year) without a live lookup. Revenue decides. Not tax advice.

Enter your income, then click Calculate.

What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: the 20% and 40% income tax bands, the personal and earned income credits, Universal Social Charge including the 3% self-employed surcharge above €100,000, Class S PRSI, and flags for preliminary tax and VAT registration.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: other income, pension relief, capital allowances, losses, marital or other credits, VAT amounts, non-residents, and exactly how much preliminary tax you must pay. Revenue or your accountant decide these.
    • 
    

  


  

    
Common questions

    
How much of my self-employed income should I set aside for tax in Ireland?

    
Often 20% to 30% of profit once you add income tax, USC and PRSI, but it depends on your profit. Enter your income and expenses here for a number built from the actual rates.

    
What is Class S PRSI?

    
The social insurance contribution paid by self-employed people, 4.2% of income with a minimum of €500 a year, collected through your Form 11 return.

    
When is preliminary tax due?

    
Self-assessed taxpayers pay preliminary tax and file Form 11 by 31 October, extended to mid-November when filing and paying through ROS.

    
When must I register for VAT?

    
Generally when turnover from services exceeds €42,500 in a 12-month period (€85,000 for goods). VAT you collect belongs to Revenue, so keep it out of your set-aside.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent.

Your answers. This page runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere; closing the tab discards them, and downloads are files on your own device.

    
Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record: nothing you enter is saved anywhere.

    
Everything runs in your browser. Your answers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (analysis_run, example_loaded, summary_downloaded) are counted only in local storage on your device, never with any of your data, and are switched off by Do Not Track.
